questiontext.text: What is the correct medical first aid treatment for a minor heat burn or hot water scald?

generalfeedback.text: Cold running water for 10–15 minutes cools the flesh, stops tissue destruction, and relieves pain. Toothpaste and oils trap heat.

answer.text: Smearing thick raw palm oil, butter, or blue toothpaste on the wound

feedback.text: Incorrect. Cold running water for 10–15 minutes cools the flesh, stops tissue destruction, and relieves pain. Toothpaste and oils trap heat.

answer.text: Holding the burned area under cold running tap water for 10 to 15 minutes

feedback.text: Correct! Cold running water for 10–15 minutes cools the flesh, stops tissue destruction, and relieves pain. Toothpaste and oils trap heat.

answer.text: Rubbing coarse cooking salt into the burn

feedback.text: Incorrect. Cold running water for 10–15 minutes cools the flesh, stops tissue destruction, and relieves pain. Toothpaste and oils trap heat.

answer.text: Cutting the skin open with a razor blade

feedback.text: Incorrect. Cold running water for 10–15 minutes cools the flesh, stops tissue destruction, and relieves pain. Toothpaste and oils trap heat.
